# Pure

> Server-rendered real-estate demo. Search is a path under `/property/`, not a query string. Read this file before building a search URL.

Pages that cover this site link it with `rel="describedby"` (`/llms.txt`). On GitHub Pages the site lives under `/pure/`, so the same file is `/pure/llms.txt` and every search path below is prefixed with `/pure`. The `/pure` segment is the deploy folder, not part of the search.

## How to search

Lowercase the state code. Turn spaces into hyphens. Strip a trailing word `city` or `county` from those names.

- State: `/property/{state}` — `/property/tx`
- County: `/property/{state}/{county}_county` — `/property/tx/harris_county`
- City: `/property/{state}/{city}` — `/property/tx/houston`
- Zip: `/property/{state}/{zip}` — `/property/tx/77002`
- Neighborhood: `/property/{state}/{city}/{neighborhood}_neighborhood`
- Address: `/property/{state}/{city}/{address}_address`
- School: `/property/{state}/{city}/{id}_school` — `{id}` is the school id (NCES id). Homes are those inside that school boundary. Example: `/property/tx/austin/483808012358_school`

`/property` and `/property/` redirect to `/property/sitemap`. Sitemap drills down: `/property/sitemap`, `/property/sitemap/{state}`, `/property/sitemap/{state}/{county}_county`, `/property/sitemap/{state}/{city}`.

A property detail URL is `/property/detail/{state}/{zip}/{propertyId}`. A map URL is `/property/{state}/{slug}/@{lat},{lng}`.

A non-canonical geo path redirects to the normalized path. Example: `/property/austin/tx` redirects to `/property/tx/austin`.

Filters are query parameters on the geo path. Enums are lowercase. A range is `{min}_{max}`; either side may be empty.

- `price` — `minPrice` / `maxPrice`
- `bed` — `minBed` / `maxBed`
- `bath` — `minBath` / `maxBath`
- `propertyType[]` — `single_family`, `condo`, `multi_family`, `mobile`, `land`, `other`
- `propertyStatus[]` — `sold`, `rental`. Omitted means for sale
- `photo=true`
- `construction=true` — dropped when status is `sold` or `rental`
- `openhouse=true` — dropped when status is `sold` or `rental`
- `size` — page size
- `index` — page index
- `sort` — `price`, `list_date`
- `order` — `asc`, `desc`
